<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈133.102 Da. The formula that matches this mass within sub‑ppm accuracy is C₁₀H₁₃ (exact mass 133.101725 Da). No oxygen or other hetero atoms are required, so we report O = 0 and omit any additional element X.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13O0</final_answer>
